title: A long shot at what price?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the actual win probability behind betting value.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the actual win probability behind betting value affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Expected, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the actual win probability behind betting value in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy gamble gains 190 with probability 0.04 and loses 10 otherwise. What is its expected cash change?
